summary: Verified deployment health-check fix. GET /health on backend (port 8001) returns 200 {"status":"ok"} with no auth, as added at /app/backend/server.py:23-25 outside the /api prefix. GET /api/ still returns {"message":"My Builder App API"}. Full iteration 7 regression suite (21 tests across Digest/Shopping/RentYield/ShareReport) all PASS. Public-URL smoke test for demo user: POST /api/auth/login OK; GET /api/project, /api/digest?week=0, /api/shopping all return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Note: Public ingress only routes /api/* to backend; GET /health via public URL hits the Expo frontend (returns HTML with 200). The platform health check must probe the backend container directly (port 8001) for the fix to be observed. If the deployment agent uses the public URL, consider also exposing /api/health or ensure the health probe targets the backend service directly.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') hooks (lines 32, 56). Migrate to lifespan context manager for future-proofing (not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Health endpoint lives at app-level (outside /api router) in /app/backend/server.py. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py for regression (21 tests, ~7s). Public base URL comes from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Demo creds: demo@mybuilder.app / demo1234; login response key is access_token (not token).
